versions.changelog:
- Added 16 new California 14er routes, expanding coverage from 16 to 32 peaks in the route database.
- Updated peak_routes.json to include detailed info for the additional California routes.
- Documentation (SKILL.md) now lists all available routes by region (PNW, California 14ers).
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.
- No changes to basic usage, forecast logic, or input/output formats.

Alpinist Route Forecast v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Provides route-aware, terrain-adjusted weather forecasts for alpine climbs, including summit and descent conditions.
- Supports named classic routes (16 PNW peaks), any GPX file, or simple elevation profiles.
- Delivers confidence-rated, multi-day forecasts using Open-Meteo, NOAA/NWS (US), and Mountain-Forecast.com (public pages).
- Learns your pace over time through post-trip calibration for more accurate, customized timing.
- Outputs detailed hourly weather, route-based itinerary, warnings, and verification from multiple sources.
- Data handling is privacy-focused: personal pace data is stored locally and forecast queries transmit route coordinates only.
